description: This file defines data models and functions for handling discovery information related to AWS IoT Greengrass, including classes for connectivity info, core and group connectivity, and discovery data parsing.

classes.name: ConnectivityInfo
classes.description: Stores a set of connectivity information including id, host, port, and metadata.

classes.name: CoreConnectivityInfo
classes.description: Stores connectivity info for a Greengrass core, including methods to access and append connectivity info.

classes.name: GroupConnectivityInfo
classes.description: Stores connectivity info for a Greengrass group, including methods to access cores, CAs, and append info.

classes.name: DiscoveryInfo
classes.description: Represents the overall discovery response, with methods to parse and retrieve core, CA, and group info.

methods.name: getAllCores
methods.description: Retrieves all core connectivity info objects from the discovery data.

methods.name: getAllCas
methods.description: Retrieves all CA pairs (groupId, caContent) from the discovery data.

methods.name: getAllGroups
methods.description: Retrieves all group connectivity info objects.

methods.name: toObjectAtGroupLevel
methods.description: Returns a dictionary of group IDs to GroupConnectivityInfo objects for targeted access.

methods.name: _decode_group_info
methods.description: Decodes a group JSON object into a GroupConnectivityInfo instance.

methods.name: _decode_core_info
methods.description: Decodes a core JSON object into a CoreConnectivityInfo instance.
